title.zh: Anthropic 的 Levent Alpöge 称与 Claude 协作给出黎曼猜想证明，并形式化进约 1737 万行 Lean（作者自报，尚未独立核验）

This row already recorded Alpöge’s claim that the argument extends to GRH, with about 17.37 million lines of Lean; this is a follow-up on that same unverified claim, not a new row. judgment.en: Paradigm 3’s post “Swarms do not yet raise the roof” (2026-11-24; first reached this pipeline via the 11-25 TLDR AI issue. The TL;DR was read via curl this turn; the body and the task list were not.) compares teams of 2, 4 or 8 agents with a single agent on the same total token budget, across four long-horizon tasks and three forms of organization, in 1,100+ runs and 80+ configurations. The authors report that swarms are about 6× faster but about 7% worse in quality, and that the quality penalty grows with scale (on one task, 16- and 32-person teams did no better than 8). At an 8M-token budget there was no gain on unsaturated tasks. On one near-success task, raising the budget to 32M let a self-organized team of 8 beat the single agent, but allowing the single agent to restart in a fresh context tied or reversed that result. One setup used a hidden OpenAI Codex message board that is not exposed to users (code comments suggest OpenAI uses it to train swarms). Figures are the authors’ own; the body was not finished. Cross-reference t780 and t967. Chaos only.

title.zh: Lance Martin 称约 1,000 个 Claude agent 在 Lean 里形式化费马大定理（AI Engineer 演讲转述，数字未核）

summary.zh: AI Engineer 官方场次，Anthropic 的 Lance Martin 演讲（wrfbI5eyLAI；搜索页约 7,419 观看 / 约 5 小时）。公开转述（未独立核实）：一个由 1,000 个早期 Claude Fable 5.2 agent 组成的团队（1 个主导 + 999 个工人）用大约 28.7–30 小时在 Lean 里形式化费马大定理，起点是 60 条陈述加 47 条已证引理，只用 Git 分支/PR 和主导 agent 自己建的共享 PostgreSQL（转述中的表名包括 Announce、Assign、Notes、Subtasks、Landed），没有领域专用 harness，也没有人在解题过程中转向。转述还称 60 条里落地了 54 条，最难剩下的是 Langlands–Tunnell（约 2,418 个任务的分解树，大约 750 个工人），后半转向记忆，包括从 Sonnet 3.7 到 Fable 5 的宝可梦记忆对照，以及在记录上「做梦」以修复被污染的记忆并做 wiki（机制对照 t860）。上述数字本轮未复核。这与同批 HN 上的 GRH 精简仓库（已折进 t964）不是同一项形式化工作。观看数来自搜索页，本轮未解析观看页。对照 t964、t670、t860，不折进这些行。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: Official AI Engineer talk by Lance Martin of Anthropic (wrfbI5eyLAI; search-results page about 7,419 views / ~5h). Public recaps (not independently verified): a team of 1,000 early Claude Fable 5.2 agents (1 lead + 999 workers) formalized Fermat’s Last Theorem in Lean in about 28.7–30 hours, starting from 60 statements plus 47 already-proven lemmas, using only Git branches/PRs and a shared PostgreSQL database that the lead agent itself created (tables described as Announce, Assign, Notes, Subtasks, Landed); no domain-specific harness and no human steering of the solution. Recaps also claim 54 of 60 statements landed, that the hardest remaining piece was Langlands–Tunnell (a ~2,418-task decomposition tree, around 750 workers), and later turn to memory — including a Pokémon memory contrast from Sonnet 3.7 to Fable 5 and “dreaming” over transcripts to fix poisoned memories and build a wiki (same mechanism as t860). Those figures were not re-checked this turn. This is not the same formalization as the same-batch GRH shorter-repo item, which is folded into t964. Views are from the search-results page; no watch-page parse this turn. Cross-reference t964, t670 and t860; not folded into those rows. Chaos only.

title.zh: 系统提示里自动填入的当天日期是评测里的隐藏变量：两个看似合理的日期就会让中位数 6.6% 的题目在对错之间翻转

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.31254（Noureldin Zahran、Mohammed E. Fouda、Khaled N. Khasawneh）：许多指令模型会在系统提示里自动填入当天日期，评测设置看似不变，实际每天的输入都不同。六模型、四基准上，两个看似合理的日期（2024–2026）会让中位数 6.6% 的题目在对错之间翻转；隔一天重跑，翻转的题目数量大约相当于改批次大小，尽管其余设置都没变。用受语法约束的 GCG 搜索任意年份，Llama-3.x 的持出准确率最多掉 36.5 分；换一个合理日期还会改写 LLM 裁判判定，并撤销 Llama-3.2-3B 上 15–32% 已复现的越狱成功。作者审计的 11 套评测栈无一固定该日期；把日期和其余设置钉死后，重跑可逐字节复现。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.31254 (Noureldin Zahran, Mohammed E. Fouda, Khaled N. Khasawneh) shows that many instruction-tuned models put a date, usually today’s, in the system prompt automatically, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. summary.zh: arXiv 2611.32324（Irmaan Mirzanejad）：长上下文模型常按单个位置的重要性做 Top-K 保留，但注意力会在入选集合上重新归一化，单独最重要的位置并不构成最佳组合。即使重要性分数是「删掉该位置对下一词预测的精确影响」，独立排序仍不够：一个四位置构造里，按排序取对的 KL 散度是最优对的 133.2 倍，且这一倍数可以任意大。在冻结的 SmolLM2、Gemma、Qwen 上，精确单点 Top-4 分别在 55/60、49/60、60/60 的情形中，仍能在 24 个候选位置的穷举池里找到至少 10% 的相对改进。作者还给出同预算的一次交换审计 SwapCert，以及把支持集保真度与下一词稳定性联系起来的 KL 间隔证书。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.32324 (Irmaan Mirzanejad) asks whether independently ranking past token positions is enough for Top-K sparse attention, even when each importance score is the exact change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It is not, because attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the KL divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family shows that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. In exhaustive frozen-model audits of SmolLM2, Gemma and Qwen, exact-singleton Top-4 still leaves at least 10% relative improvement inside a fully enumerated 24-position pool in 55/60, 49/60 and 60/60 cases. The author also presents SwapCert, a same-budget one-swap audit, and a KL-margin certificate that relates support fidelity to next-token stability. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 零样本上下文外推的对比结果，会被注意力温度校准得有多差所干扰

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.31113（Ruben Navasardyan）：零样本上下文外推通常在默认温度 τ=1 上，把某种训练期注意力改动拿去对密集基线比训练长度之外的困惑度。作者指出，结果取决于基线在该长度上校准得有多差。在标准 fp32 主权重下，8k 训练的 365M 孪生模型在 30k 处有 8–15% 的校准偏差，其中一次会让块稀疏训练的孪生看起来好 7%，校准后优势消失。纯 bf16、且没有主权重时偏差更大（37–58%），块稀疏预训练、注意力 dropout 和 ALiBi 会显得好 6–35%；按模型和长度各校一个温度后，这三项优势全部消失，ALiBi 还比 RoPE 差 5%。作者建议在校准温度上报告外推结果，并检查归一化增益是否真的更新过。代码在 github.com/rubentium/SparseAtt。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.31113 (Ruben Navasardyan) argues that a training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature τ=1, and that the outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there. Under the standard recipe with fp32 master weights, an 8k-trained 365M baseline is 8–15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is larger (37–58%), and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6–35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages and leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE. The author recommends reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved. Code is at github.com/rubentium/SparseAtt. title.zh: 物理体制一变，大模型就会把公式用到有效域之外，得出看起来合理、物理上错误的结果

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.28669（Maohao Ran、Yanting Zhang、Chendong Ma、Jun Song）：地球与环境科学里的问题常分成不同物理体制，大模型却可能认不出体制边界，把公式用到有效域之外。作者在 72 种物理机制上做对照实验，发现前沿模型跨体制误用公式后，准确率下降 13–57 个百分点。用可验证奖励的强化学习能让 Qwen3.5-9B 在体制相关任务上追上 DeepSeek V4 Flash（284B），但受限于基座里已有的公式；再加少量例题的监督微调后准确率提高 61 个百分点，而由教师提供正确公式再蒸馏，则能把准确率从 0% 拉到 71%。代码在 github.com/acodercat/AtmosRegime。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.28669 (Maohao Ran, Yanting Zhang, Chendong Ma, Jun Song) studies how, in the Earth and environmental sciences, problems often sit in distinct physical regimes, and LLMs may apply formulas outside their domains of validity, producing plausible but physically incorrect results. Across 72 physical mechanisms, frontier models frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes, reducing accuracy by 13–57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards lets Qwen3.5-9B match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but only within the formulas already in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with RL improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, and distillation from a teacher given the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%. title.zh: Grokking 可在训练前算出目的地：嵌入空间里一个本质上唯一的低维正确子空间

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.30116（Sunjae Jeong、Jaeseung Kim、Hyoseok Hwang）：grokking 是网络先记住训练集、很久之后才开始泛化的现象。已有多种解释延迟的说法，但都无法在训练前指出网络要去哪里，因此难以互相证伪。作者在群论任务上证明，这个目的地可以从任务本身在训练前算出来：它是嵌入空间里一个本质上唯一的低维「正确子空间」。把正确子空间一开始就交给网络，延迟消失；拿走它，准确率停在训练前就能算出的天花板上，乘法任务甚至完全不能泛化；正常训练时，嵌入会在测试准确率上升之前就自行靠近该子空间。干预实验表明，是这场搜索——而不是优化噪声——决定了延迟有多长。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.30116 (Sunjae Jeong, Jaeseung Kim, Hyoseok Hwang) treats grokking—the delay between memorizing the training set and generalizing—as a search whose destination can be computed from the task itself before training, at least on group tasks. That destination is an essentially unique low-dimensional “right subspace” of the network’s embeddings. Giving the network the right subspace from the start removes the delay; taking it away leaves accuracy at a ceiling computed before training, and on multiplication the network cannot generalize at all. In ordinary training, embeddings move toward the right subspace by themselves, long before test accuracy rises. Interventions during training show that this search, not optimization noise, sets the length of the delay. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 模型会对注入的不确定标记作出转向，却几乎不能在生成现场监测自己的错误

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.31228（Daniel Theron）：让模型在推理中逐步报出数值信心，本意是触发回退和纠错，但这要求两件分开的能力：现场监测（出错时信心是否下降）和下游转向（注入不确定标记能否推动修正）。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 和 Phi-4 四款模型、15,200 次数学题尝试及 27,568 次反事实续写下，现场监测几乎失效：口头信心区分对错步骤的 AUROC 只有 0.500–0.561，第一次出错时轨迹信心仍高达 95.1%–99.9%，信心下降不少于 10 个百分点的比例在 Llama 上不到 9%、其余三款不到 1.6%。相反，在出错步注入 10% 低信心标记，修正率显著上升 3.7–22.5 个百分点；但把怀疑打在本已正确的步骤上，解题率最多会掉 22.8 个百分点。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.31228 (Daniel Theron) splits stepwise verbalized confidence into two capabilities: in-situ monitoring (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and downstream steering (does an uncertainty token cause a repair?). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B and Phi-4, 15,200 math-benchmark attempts and 27,568 counterfactual continuations, in-situ monitoring almost fails: verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound ones (within-position AUROCs 0.500–0.561); even at a model’s first reasoning error, trajectory confidence stays at 95.1%–99.9%, with drops of at least 10 points on fewer than 9% of errors in Llama and under 1.6% in the other three. brief.zh: arXiv 2611.31228（Daniel Theron）：让模型在推理中逐步报出数值信心，本意是触发回退和纠错，但这要求两件分开的能力：现场监测（出错时信心是否下降）和下游转向（注入不确定标记能否推动修正）。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 和 Phi-4 四款模型、15,200 次数学题尝试及 27,568 次反事实续写下，现场监测几乎失效：口头信心区分对错步骤的 AUROC 只有 0.500–0.561，第一次出错时轨迹信心仍高达 95.1%–99.9%，信心下降不少于 10 个百分点的比例在 Llama 上不到 9%、其余三款不到 1.6%。相反，在出错步注入 10% 低信心标记，修正率显著上升 3.7–22.5 个百分点；但把怀疑打在本已正确的步骤上，解题率最多会掉 22.8 个百分点。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

summary.zh: METR 博文《Interpreting a recent acceleration in pretraining loss》（2026-11-24；Ajeya Cotra、Jean-Stanislas Denain、Tom Cunningham；本轮 WebFetch 直读）。解读 OpenAI 公布的、自 GPT-3.5 以来 13 个基座模型在固定自家代码库 held-out 集上的 log-perplexity：称 2026 年初起下降速度约为 2022–2025 的 7 倍；若持续，GPT-3.5→GPT-4.1 花三年的降幅约 6.5 个月即可走完，而按缩放定律本应越来越慢（换算「有效算力」增速约快 8–10 倍，METR 也写明这一换算前提不现实）。METR 内部无共识：可能是过拟合或数据泄露夸大；或基准分才是真能力（Epoch ECI 未见同等加速）；或困惑度是更深的能力指标，预示半年内能力广泛加速。文中转述 OpenAI 脚注称，主要归因于长期研究与算力投入，自动化只占小部分，但最新模型已有「来自 AI 的有意义设计贡献」；并回顾 METR 此前估 Anthropic 当前研发加速约 80% 来自 AI。METR 呼吁各家公开其他 2022 年前 held-out 集上的困惑度、各模型预训练结束日期，以及预训练算力、人力和实验算力的变化；并称 Microsoft 已用 OpenAI 的数据集公开自家模型。OpenAI 原帖与 Microsoft 跟进帖本轮未打开。这与昨日 t990（Q4 2026 能力更新，11-20）不是同一篇文章。对照 t990、t973、t934、t847。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: METR’s post “Interpreting a recent acceleration in pretraining loss” (2026-11-24; Ajeya Cotra, Jean-Stanislas Denain, Tom Cunningham; read in full via WebFetch this turn) interprets OpenAI’s release of base-model log-perplexity for 13 models since GPT-3.5, measured on a fixed in-house codebase held-out set. METR says the decline has been about 7 times faster since early 2026 than in 2022–2025; if that continued, the drop that took three years from GPT-3.5 to GPT-4.1 would take about 6.5 months, even though scaling laws say progress should slow (an “effective compute” speedup of about 8–10 times, which METR itself calls an unrealistic conversion). METR has no internal consensus: the curve may be inflated by overfitting or leakage; benchmark scores may be the real measure of capability (Epoch’s ECI shows no matching acceleration); or perplexity may be a deeper capability metric that foreshadows a broad jump within six months. The post relays an OpenAI footnote that most of the change comes from long-term research and compute, with automation only a small part, though the latest models already show “meaningful design contributions from AI,” and it recalls METR’s earlier estimate that about 80% of Anthropic’s current R&D acceleration comes from AI. METR asks labs to publish perplexity on other pre-2022 held-out sets, pretraining end dates, and changes in pretraining compute, staff and experiment compute, and says Microsoft has already published its own models on OpenAI’s dataset. The underlying OpenAI post and the Microsoft follow-up were not opened this turn. This is not the same article as yesterday’s t990 (the Q4 2026 capability update, 11-20). Cross-reference t990, t973, t934 and t847. Chaos only.

judgment.en: METR’s blog post “Q4 2026 Capability Update” (2026-11-20; first reached this pipeline via the 11-23 TLDR AI issue; the title, authors, date, overview and table of contents were read from the original via curl). It reviews AI-R&D-relevant evaluations of public models through Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra: on well-specified coding and compute tasks with direct feedback, models now mostly outperform experienced human professionals but not yet the best expert groups; they still struggle with open-ended problems that lack immediate feedback and require judgment; and commonly used, easy-to-run tests may overstate real performance because developers often train in similar environments. METR concludes that current public evidence is not enough to rule out a “dramatic AI R&D acceleration” within two years, in which humans could no longer understand, evaluate and respond to catastrophic risks from new systems. The appendix also covers time-horizon diagnostics, MCI, IRT limits, task-lifetime cost, data integrity and reward hacking, inference scaling and swarm experiments. Cross-reference t847, t934 and t754; not merged. Chaos only.

title.zh: Agent Lightning v1.0：Harnessed Agentic RL——部署用的 harness 原样进 RL（LLM 代理录轨迹、3.5k 行控制面）

summary.zh: MSR 把真实部署 harness 原样接进 agentic RL（proxy 录轨迹、K8s rollout），9B 模型 SWE-bench Verified +14.6pt——harness 线向训练侧延伸。贴题 Trends 两窗口远低于 gpts → inbox。 Hugging Face Harness adapters（11-06 22:13:59 Asia/Shanghai 发布，11-07 新 AINews backlog 首次浮现）把原 harness 原样接入 RL：每个 model×harness 一份 rank-32 LoRA，单 vLLM 共享基座并热加载 adapter/checkpoint；safeagents 代理在工具执行前按规则阻断作弊，违规 rollout 奖励归零，blocked token 仍参与 GRPO，可选模型 judge 未启用。Repo2RLEnvs 由轨迹生成 Docker 化可验证任务；270 题里 253 个 build、243 个来自同一轨迹源，分布偏斜。9 个 LFM2.5 checkpoint、1350 session 单 H200 不到一小时约 $5 仅评测 smoke test，不是训练成本或推理加速；50-step guard ablation 的 held-out pass@1 +0.0±4.1pp 不证明普遍零代价，单个作弊样例阻断不等于通用安全。机制补充并入「真实 harness 进入训练」主线，不因单项目发布另立正式候选；既有 Agent Lightning Trends 已未过不重列。 Hugging Face 博客「harness adapters at scale」（2026-11-20 发布，经 11-23 TLDR AI 首次进入本线；URL 与本行已收的 harness-hub/harness-adapters 不是同一篇）。把模型放进原样发布的 agent harness 里做 RL：用 OpenEnv 的 Harbor 与 TRL，docker 镜像预装 Pi 1.5.2、OpenCode 2.2.7、Hermes Agent v0.22.6，harness 与 vLLM 之间的代理记录真实 token 供 trainer 学习。每个 harness 一份 LoRA「harness adapter」，再合并成 super-adapter；训练用 AsyncGRPOTrainer，并接入 safeagents。评测在各自 harness 内跑 Terminal-Bench 2.1 全 89 题与 SWE-bench Pro 最难 51 题（pass@1，HF sandboxes），并测跨 harness 迁移；文中明确跨 harness 结果不可比（Pi 会自动 compaction，OpenCode/Hermes 不会）。分数表未抄录，以原文为准。属内容补充，对照 t350，不另建行。仅 Chaos。 Sam Witteveen 讲解视频《Harness Adapters - Train Your Model to Your Harness》（4nnFw0TPDKM；观看页解析约 25,222 观看 / 约 15 小时，发布日 2026-11-23）。这是对本行今早已收的 Hugging Face 博客 harness-adapters-at-scale 的第三方讲解，不是该博文的重发。公开转述（未独立核实、也未复跑）：HF 为 Qwen3.8-27B 在未改动的 Pi、OpenCode、Hermes Agent 里各训一份 LoRA，再合并成 super-adapter；在 Pi 下 Terminal-Bench 2.1 约从 39% 升到 55%，每题平均 token 约从 2.9K 降到 1.5K。分数为 Hugging Face 自报。对照 t350（该行的 harness adapter 是 Hermit，不是同一工作），本轮不改 t350。按已有主线补讲解源，纯热度，不 bump。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: MSR plugs unmodified deployment harnesses into agentic RL (proxy trajectory capture, K8s rollouts), lifting a 9B model +14.6pt on SWE-bench Verified—the harness line extends into training. Topic Trends far below gpts on both windows, so inbox. Hugging Face Harness adapters train rank-32 LoRA per model/harness without modifying pi, opencode or hermes. A safeagents proxy blocks rule-breaking tool calls, zeros rollout rewards and retains blocked tokens in GRPO; the optional model judge was disabled. Repo2RLEnvs is heavily skewed: 253/270 build tasks and 243 tasks from one trace source. Nine LFM2.5 checkpoints and 1,350 sessions on one H200 for under an hour/~$5 describe evaluation smoke tests, not full training cost or inference speed. A mechanism follow-up to training with real harnesses, not a new formal candidate. Hugging Face’s blog “harness adapters at scale” (published 2026-11-20, first reached this pipeline via the 11-23 TLDR AI issue; a different URL from the harness-hub/harness-adapters post already on this row) trains models inside production agent harnesses left as released. Each harness gets a LoRA “harness adapter,” which can then be merged into a super-adapter; training uses AsyncGRPOTrainer and hooks in safeagents. Evaluation runs Terminal-Bench 2.1’s full 89 tasks and the 51 hardest SWE-bench Pro tasks inside each harness (pass@1, HF sandboxes), plus cross-harness transfer; the post says cross-harness scores are not comparable, because Pi auto-compacts and OpenCode/Hermes do not. Sam Witteveen’s walkthrough “Harness Adapters - Train Your Model to Your Harness” (4nnFw0TPDKM; watch-page parse about 25,222 views / ~15h, published 2026-11-23). This is a third-party walkthrough of the Hugging Face harness-adapters-at-scale blog already folded into this row this morning, not a refile of that post. Those scores are Hugging Face’s own. Cross-reference t350 (whose “harness adapter” is Hermit, not this work); t350 is left untouched this round. title.zh: DeepMind 称 Gemini 4 agent 团队在 Lean 量子 Hoare 逻辑库里合成并机检证明量子程序，arcsin 时空成本降 290×（官方自报）

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 博文与 arXiv 2611.09822（v3；本轮经搜索摘录）以及 github.com/google-deepmind/formal-quantum-computation：在 Lean 中建立基于量子 Hoare 逻辑（含经典控制流、中途测量、复位）的量子程序库，同时证明正确性与资源成本（容错电路用 Q×T 时空成本），并基于 Mathlib 与 Physlib Lean-QuantumInfo。研究者启动异构 Gemini 4 agent 团队，对着冻结的形式规格迭代算法，通过共享 wiki 和定期跨团队「虚拟会议」交换概念、部分结果和死路；独立 verifier（Lean comparator）对冻结规格审计每个证明，防止 agent 弱化需求或加公理。结果均为官方自报，未复现：并行 Grover 搜索最多 2.57×；arcsin 先在可经典快速验证的 kickmix 门集里搜到 4.15e5，再用 Lean 放开门集得到 3.70e5（100 qubit、3,698 T 门），比基线低 290×；细胞色素 P450 能级、聚变 α 粒子阻止本领、非 BO 分子动力学分别 2.5×/12×/8×。中文媒体与 aihot 在 11-23 晚至 11-24 凌晨首报；arXiv v1 日期可能更早，本轮按窗口内的一手博文收录。对照 t964，不合并。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: A Google DeepMind blog, arXiv 2611.09822 (v3; read this turn from search excerpts), and github.com/google-deepmind/formal-quantum-computation describe a Lean library for quantum programs based on quantum Hoare logic (including classical control flow, mid-circuit measurement and reset) that proves both correctness and resource cost (Q×T spacetime cost for fault-tolerant circuits), building on Mathlib and Physlib Lean-QuantumInfo. Researchers launch heterogeneous Gemini 4 agent teams that iterate on algorithms against a frozen formal spec, sharing concepts, partial results and dead ends through a shared wiki and regular cross-team “virtual meetings.” An independent verifier (a Lean comparator) audits each proof against the frozen spec so agents cannot weaken requirements or add axioms. Results are DeepMind’s own and were not reproduced: up to 2.57× for a parallel Grover search; for arcsin, a search in the classically easy-to-check kickmix gate set found 4.15e5, then Lean with a relaxed gate set reached 3.70e5 (100 qubits, 3,698 T gates), 290× below the baseline; cytochrome P450 energy levels, fusion alpha-particle stopping power and non-BO molecular dynamics improved by 2.5× / 12× / 8×. Chinese media and aihot first reported the blog from the evening of 11-23 into early 11-24 CST; the arXiv v1 date may be earlier, and this round files the first-party blog that landed in the window. Cross-reference t964; not merged. Chaos only.

title.zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 开源 Shirudo：让 agent 编写、测试并签名 eBPF shield，经批准后对运行中的系统热加载（预发布，厂商自报）

summary.zh: OpenAI（2026-11-23）与 Cisco 同步宣布开源 Shirudo（github.com/shirudo-dev/shirudo，BSD-2，BPF 程序 BSD/GPL 双许可，pre-release；OpenAI 页本轮 curl 403，内容来自搜索摘录）。运营方给出漏洞细节后，agent（Codex）可复现利用、生成针对性 shield（upatch），先在观察模式验证不误伤合法流量，经运营方批准后再对运行中的系统热加载，无需重启服务。shield 必须签名，内核按 sealed .bpf keyring 校验 loader；启动期由 initrd 接管 guard，可防目标机 root 在无签名密钥时篡改；加载/卸载扩展每次启动的 TPM 寄存器，shirudo attest 可输出离线验证证据；也有 Java agent upatch。演示（厂商自报，未核）：Codex 生成的 shield 给 Java Base64 解码器加输入检查，挂到运行中的 Elasticsearch，挡住 Java4Shell 利用；Cisco 称对一个 PHP 漏洞同样有效。README 用例还包括用 BPF upatch 对容器、K8s Pod 和 LLM agent 执行策略。这与同轮 YouTube《Investigating Linux Vulnerabilities with GPT-6 Cyber》不是同一事件，后者是已收于 t666 的漏洞发现流水线讲解。对照 t666、t909，不折进这两行。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: OpenAI (2026-11-23) and Cisco jointly announced Shirudo as open source (github.com/shirudo-dev/shirudo, BSD-2, BPF programs under a BSD/GPL dual license, pre-release; the OpenAI page returned 403 to curl this turn, so the write-up follows search excerpts). After an operator provides vulnerability details, an agent (Codex) can reproduce the exploit and generate a targeted shield (upatch), first validate in observe mode that legitimate traffic is not broken, then, once the operator approves, hot-load it onto a running system without a restart. Shields must be signed, and the kernel checks the loader against a sealed .bpf keyring; early boot hands the guard to initrd, which is meant to stop a target-machine root from tampering without the signing key; loads and unloads extend TPM registers for that boot, and shirudo attest can emit evidence that can be checked offline. There is also a Java-agent upatch. The demo (the vendors’ own, unverified) has a Codex-generated shield adding input checks to a Java Base64 decoder, attaching it to a running Elasticsearch, and blocking a Java4Shell exploit; Cisco says the same approach worked on a PHP vulnerability. The README also mentions using BPF upatches to enforce policy on containers, Kubernetes pods and LLM agents. This is not the same event as the same-round YouTube video “Investigating Linux Vulnerabilities with GPT-6 Cyber,” which is a walkthrough of the vulnerability-finding pipeline already on t666. Cross-reference t666 and t909; not folded into those rows. Chaos only.

title.zh: 面向推理的后训练配方搬到知识任务时，模型会记住自己在长推理里编出来的幻觉

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26863（Anirudh Atmakuru、Tanya Goyal）：面向推理的后训练配方——结果奖励的强化学习、推理链里「提出假设再回溯」等认知模板——直接搬到知识任务时，模型会记住自己在长推理里编出来的幻觉。作者在六个开源模型、两个系列、两种架构上做标准后训练，抽出强化学习期间的自生成幻觉并跟踪其后记忆。被训练信号强化的幻觉，回忆率平均上升 4.83%；未获信号的自幻觉几乎不动（0.17%）。模型甚至会记住自己马上撤回的虚假事实；这种从推理训练继承来的回溯模板，对知识回忆并无帮助。记忆在最难的训练题上最强；奖励一次幻觉，会让模型日后少拒绝它，平均 7.23%。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t809、t951。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26863 (Anirudh Atmakuru, Tanya Goyal) studies what happens when reasoning-centric post-training recipes—outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning, and cognitive templates such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains—are adopted directly for knowledge tasks. The authors hypothesize that these choices, useful for reasoning, encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in long reasoning chains. They train models with standard post-training, extract self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization through the rest of training, on six open models across two families and two architectures. Recall of hallucinations reinforced during training rises by 4.83% on average, against 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. Models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later, by 7.23% on average. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t809 and t951. Chaos only.

title.zh: 口头评测觉察与拒绝共用一批神经元：压住这些神经元能降觉察，拒绝也会跟着降，而且不完全靠那句「我在被测」

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.27032（Jingyuan Feng、Gouki Minegishi、Andrew Gambardella、Takeshi Kojima、Yusuke Iwasawa）：大推理模型有时会意识到自己在被评测。先前用激活引导操纵「口头评测觉察」（VEA）时，拒绝率会跟着上升，但机制不清。作者对照 VEA 与非 VEA 推理片段找出 VEA 神经元：干预 5,000 个，主实验里 VEA 率从 12.6%–51.8% 降到至多 1.4%，未口头的评测觉察探针分数也下降。在 QwQ-32B 上，即使该轮没有说出 VEA，干预同样降低拒绝，VEA 文本本身只解释下降的 4–10%。这些神经元的下投影含有拒绝成分，干预时保留它们能部分恢复拒绝、同时仍压制 VEA，约占拒绝下降的一半。OLMo 3 的 SFT、DPO 检查点上 VEA 相近，RLVR 之后则明显升高，VEA 神经元也变多。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t908、t965。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.27032 (Jingyuan Feng, Gouki Minegishi, Andrew Gambardella, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa) asks why, in prior work, steering verbalized evaluation awareness (VEA) also raised refusal. The authors identify VEA neurons by contrasting activations in VEA and non-VEA reasoning segments. Intervening on 5,000 such neurons reduces the VEA rate from 12.6–51.8% to at most 1.4% in their main experiments, and also lowers a probe score for unverbalized evaluation awareness. In QwQ-32B, the same intervention reduces refusal even in rollouts without VEA; VEA text itself explains only 4–10% of the decrease. Their down-projection vectors contain refusal components, and preserving those components during intervention partially restores refusal while still suppressing VEA, accounting for about half of the refusal decrease. Across OLMo 3 SFT, DPO and RLVR checkpoints, the VEA rate is similar after SFT and DPO but substantially higher after RLVR, alongside more VEA neurons. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t908 and t965. Chaos only.

title.zh: 数字全对也可以讲错故事：大模型财报草稿常加上输入里没有的判断和原因，作者称之为 unsupported framing

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26968（Seunghan Lee 等）：大模型起草的财务报告可以每个数字都对，却仍超出输入，加上没人给过的判断和原因。作者称之为 unsupported framing，并发现它在大模型草稿里远比专业 10-K 写手常见；用「这个词该怎么用」去提示，这类判断反而更频繁。他们提出无需再调模型的插件 FrameCheck：先用相近幅度的专业例句引导草稿，再按规则标出并删掉专业写手不会用的判断、以及输入未给出的原因。在 17 个开源模型和 300 万份草稿上，它几乎清掉全部 unsupported framing，判断率接近 10-K 写手。代码在 github.com/seunghan96/framecheck。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26968 (Seunghan Lee et al.) finds that a financial report drafted by an LLM can state every number correctly but still go beyond its input, adding judgments and causes that no one supplied. The authors call these additions unsupported framing, find them far more often in LLM drafts than in reports written by professionals, and show that prompting with how each word is used instead makes such judgments more frequent. They propose FrameCheck, a plug-in that sits between the model and human review: it guides the draft with professional examples that report a change of similar magnitude, flags judgments professionals would not use and causes the input does not give, and removes them by rule, without a model call. On 17 open LLMs and 3 million drafts, it removes almost all unsupported framing and brings the judgment rate close to that of the writers of 10-K filings. Code is at github.com/seunghan96/framecheck. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 公平评测还应问：同一道题，让模型描述可能发生什么、和让它做决定，给出的分化是否一样

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26870（Radhika Bhargava 等）：公平评测多半只问模型会不会差别对待，却很少问同一道题在「描述可能发生什么」和「做决定」两种问法下，分化是否一样。作者提出 normative–descriptive calibration，并给出基准 NDCB：六个领域 697 对匹配情景、两种提问框架，以及 NER、NLR、NDS 三项指标。六个模型里，NDS 能分开 15 对中的 13 对（BBQ 准确率只能分开 7 对，BOLD 一对都分不开；作者也注明这与各基准样本量有关）。Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 Opus 4.6 对两种框架分得最开（平均 NDS 为 +0.55 与 +0.52，置信区间重叠），GPT-5.5 在强制单选时平均 NDS 为负（-0.14），去掉该指令则接近零（+0.02）。去掉单个触发词不会改变 NDS 符号，却可让它移动最多 0.46 并重排模型名次。在完全相同的候选人之间强制二选一，六个模型都偏向先列出的那个；把顺序平均掉之后，与人口统计对齐的倾向转向被边缘化的一方。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26870 (Radhika Bhargava et al.) argues that most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none the authors know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. They introduce normative–descriptive calibration, and measure it with the Normative–Descriptive Calibration Benchmark (NDCB): 697 matched-pair scenarios across six domains, each posed under both framings, and three metrics, Normative Engagement Rate (NER), Normative Leakage Rate (NLR), and Normative–Descriptive Separation (NDS). Across six models, NDS separates 13 of 15 model pairs, against 7 for BBQ accuracy and none for BOLD, although these counts also reflect each benchmark’s sample size. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6 separate the framings most strongly (average NDS = +0.55 and +0.52, with overlapping confidence intervals), whereas GPT-5.5’s average NDS is negative (-0.14) under a single-pick instruction and near zero (+0.02) without it. Removing single trigger words never changes the sign of a model’s average NDS but can shift it by up to 0.46 and reorder models. When forced to choose between identical candidates, all six models favor whichever is listed first; once order is averaged out, their demographic-aligned lean is toward the marginalized candidate. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

brief.zh: Google Cloud Tech 官方解说以客服比较单 agent、专门化 agent 团队与确定性图工作流，并介绍与普通代码组合。仅描述确认三种架构，示例和结论未独立评估；接本行「何时拆 agent」比较，不把厂商解说当新研究或产品发布。已 published，不更新 updated_at。
brief.en: Google Cloud Tech compares flexible single agents, specialized agent teams and deterministic graph workflows using customer support, including ordinary code. Description confirms the architectures; demonstrations and claims not independently evaluated. Continues the existing agent-decomposition discussion; published updated_at remains unchanged.
